title: SalesHub CRM
problem_statement: Sales teams need better tools to manage their pipeline and close more deals. Current CRM solutions are often too complex or not suited to modern sales workflows. SalesHub will provide a simple, intuitive CRM that helps sales teams be more productive and close deals faster.
target_users: Sales representatives who want to manage their deals
Sales managers who need visibility into team performance
Business owners looking to grow their revenue
user_stories: As a sales rep, I want to track my deals in one place so that I don't lose track of opportunities
As a sales manager, I want to see how my team is performing so that I can coach them better
As a business owner, I want better sales reporting so that I can make informed decisions
As a sales rep, I want to log my calls and emails so that I have a record of all customer interactions
acceptance_criteria: Users should be able to add and update deals in the system
The CRM should have a dashboard with key sales metrics
The system should be fast and responsive

success_metrics.target: Good adoption across the sales team

risks_open_questions: Competing with Salesforce and HubSpot will be challenging
User adoption might be slow if the product is not intuitive enough
Data migration from existing tools may be complex
out_of_scope: Features that are out of scope for this version
Enterprise features for very large companies
